data.title: How the Middle East press frames debate over the Iran war? | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Coverage across the Middle East reveals sharp divides over Iran’s nuclear program, the Hormuz crisis, President Trump’s diplomacy, and who bears responsibility for the widening confrontation.
